items.html: And it is, that with regard to the second interpretation there is a difficulty, for in the explanation of the Shema we say explicitly that these Mochin, which come through the Shema, are only Mochin of VAK, and they are called complete internality. And behold, all this is only the aspect of Achor be-Achor, for the aspect of Panim be-Panim is made in the blessing of the Patriarchs itself, as mentioned there and in other places.
